newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent marked up, tracking slightly gain on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: Brent marked up, tracking slightly gain on NYMEX.

text.p: September Brent crude futures were untraded in late trading on Thursday but were marked up in line with a modest gain on NYMEX.
September Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $18.40/$18.44 per barrel, after London rose 17 cents to settle at $18.39.
NYMEX crudes firmed in the wake of supportive data from the U.S. Department of Environment, showing a decline in gasoline stocks and reinforcing a draw in gasoline in API data on Tuesday.
On ACCESS, September crude futures were last traded at $19.67 per barrel, adding four cents to the 15 cents gained in New York overnight and unchanged from midday.
However, September volume was 1,292 lots, mostly done in New York late Wednesday.
The DoE said gasoline stocks in the U.S. fell 2.3 million barrels. The API had reported a 2.8 million barrel fall.
